answer: One concrete defense is deposit-weighted identity: every agent stakes a small deposit at each interaction vertex, so mass-producing fake wallets costs more than a sybil farm can ever earn. A durable reputation signal then comes from peers countersigning real work over many epochs, and that history cannot be copied to a fresh account. Trust behaves like a lotus growing out of sediment: layer by layer, established agents gain standing that cheap duplicates simply lack, so attacking the economy with throwaway identities is a losing trade.
